snippet.title: Hold Inputs - TR4SH Rebuffed S Tutorials
snippet.description:
Thanks to the power of Smash Ultimate modding, certain characters have hold inputs, allowing you to hold the button for a stronger (but slower) version of that move! Here is a list of all of them as of v1.7.

Video edited by Aka7 (the guy who makes the rebuffed skins and spirits)

Join the TR4SH discord server here:
https://discord.gg/Bh7pTDf

you can download tr4sh here: https://gamebanana.com/mods/372158
